+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> Set[str]:
+    """Return file suffixes missing from MIME filters on affected Qt versions."""
+    # Qt 6.2.3 through 6.6.x can omit suffixes from MIME-filtered file pickers.
+    if (not qtutils.version_check("6.2.3", compiled=False) or
+            qtutils.version_check("6.7.0", compiled=False)):
+        return set()
+
+    accepted_types = list(upstream_mimetypes)
+    extra_suffixes = set()
+    for mime in accepted_types:
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            prefix = mime[:-1]
+            extra_suffixes.update(
+                suffix for suffix, mapped_mime in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mapped_mime.startswith(prefix)
+            )
+        elif "/" in mime:
+            extra_suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+
+    return extra_suffixes - set(accepted_types)
+
